chain.label: Autorotation training not representative of cruise-speed failure
chain.trigger: practice autorotations that they performed in flight training were done at airspeeds of about 80 knots

chain.label: No policy requiring OCC notification of abnormal fuel situations
chain.trigger: Air Methods did not require the communication specialist to notify the OCC of fuel-related issues or unplanned deviations

chain.label: Pilot fatigued from restricted sleep and long duty day
chain.trigger: the pilot was experiencing fatigue, which likely degraded his performance

chain.label: Pilot distracted by nonoperational personal texting
chain.trigger: the pilot's texting...was a self-induced distraction that took his attention away from his primary responsibility to ensure safe flight operations

chain.label: Incomplete/absent preflight inspection missed low fuel state
chain.trigger: the pilot did not comply with several company standard operating procedures that, if followed, would have led him to detect the helicopter's low fuel state

caused_by.evidence: personal electronic communications...could have distracted the pilot

chain.label: Helicopter departed with critically low fuel, undetected
chain.trigger: the helicopter had about 50 gallons (35 percent or about 60 minutes) of fuel when it departed STJ

caused_by.evidence: the pilot missed three discrete opportunities to identify that the helicopter had inadequate fuel to complete the assigned mission

chain.label: Pilot decided to continue mission on critically low fuel
chain.trigger: the pilot announced his intention to proceed with the mission and to obtain fuel at GPH while en route with the patient on board

caused_by.evidence: his improper decision to continue the mission and make a second departure after he became aware of a critically low fuel level
available operationally qualified personnel...who would likely have recognized the pilot's decision to continue the mission as inappropriate were not consulted
he devoted a portion of the available time to personal texting

chain.label: Engine flamed out short of GPH due to fuel exhaustion
chain.trigger: the engine lost power about 1 nm short of the airport

caused_by.evidence: the pilot departed on the second leg of the mission despite knowing that the helicopter had insufficient fuel reserves
the evidence was consistent with a loss of engine power due to fuel exhaustion occurring shortly before impact

chain.label: Pilot failed to make simultaneous aft cyclic/down collective for autorotation
chain.trigger: the pilot did not make the flight control inputs necessary to enter an autorotation, which resulted in a rapid decay in rotor rpm

caused_by.evidence: the pilot failed to make the flight control inputs necessary to enter an autorotation when the engine lost power
the pilot's autorotation training was not representative of an actual engine failure at cruise airspeed and likely contributed to the pilot's failure to execute a successful autorotation

chain.label: Rapid rotor rpm decay and uncontrolled nose-down descent
chain.trigger: the helicopter's nose dropped, the rotor rpm decayed rapidly, and the helicopter impacted terrain about 4 to 5 seconds after the unannounced loss of power

caused_by.evidence: if these flight control inputs were not promptly made, the result was a rapid decay in rotor rpm and impact with terrain in a nose-down attitude

chain.label: Helicopter struck the ground at high descent rate
chain.trigger: the helicopter impacted the ground in about a 40° nose-down attitude at a high rate of descent with a low rotor rpm

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter impacted the ground in about a 40° nose-down attitude at a high rate of descent with a low rotor rpm

chain.label: Four occupants killed
chain.trigger: the pilot, flight nurse, flight paramedic, and patient were killed

caused_by.evidence: the pilot, flight nurse, flight paramedic, and patient were killed, and the helicopter was substantially damaged by impact forces
